author: DamonAugust
body:
So yeah, i was playing this afternoon (i live in Europe to get an idea of time) and i was 'hacking'.
I'm not an IT-expert, the only thing i used was just a simple mod i use in my survival world, so if using a mod is hacking: my bad.
Thanks to this mod i can fly, and yes i flew during a fight (DTM) on one of the Nebula servers, only just for goofing around, not for winning the game (some people and a moderator can relate: i was just dodging some arrows in the air).
I know the consequences and i agree with them, but i just wanna know: when do i get un-banned (or something? I'm a non-native speaker so sorry for the bad English)? 
I promise i won't do it again, i know a second ban equals never coming back on this server and i actually like this server: i played a lot on it back in the time with the username WhiteSeaEagle (if you can check my history or something)
So somebody now where I can appeal an infraction?

title: 1st time Banned

replies.author: Two_Become_One
replies.body:
Hello,

It can take a user up to a couple of months to get a infraction appealed. Since your ban happened yesterday I don't believe that you have served enough time with the punishment. Basically you must face the consequences of your actions for a while.

So for now this appeal is Denied. You can make a new appeal once you believe that you've waited a significant amount of time.

Regards,
Devil_Fruit, Senior Moderator.
